content.title: List of Florida Gators men's basketball head coaches
content.text: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Billy Donovan, the winningest head coach in Gators men's basketball history. Todd Golden led Florida to its third national championship in program history in 2025. The following is a list of Florida Gators men's basketball head coaches. There have been 20 head coaches of the Gators in their 110-year history.[1] Florida's current head coach is Todd Golden. He was hired as the Gators' head coach in March 2022,[2] replacing Mike White, who left to become the head coach at Georgia.[3] No. Tenure Coach Years Record Pct. 1 1915–1916 C. J.
